```{r}
test <- read_csv(here::here("20250701_20250701_PUB_BID_DAM_v3.csv")) |>
  mutate(HOUR = hour(STARTTIME)) |>
  select(
    HOUR,
    RESOURCEBID_SEQ,
    SCH_BID_XAXISDATA,
    SCH_BID_Y1AXISDATA,
    STARTTIME
  ) |>
  filter(RESOURCEBID_SEQ == 100651 | RESOURCEBID_SEQ == 105280)

example <- head(test)
example[5,3] <- NA
example[6,3] <- NA

example |>
  rename(Hour = HOUR,
       ` Generator ID` = RESOURCEBID_SEQ,
        `Quantity (MW)` = SCH_BID_XAXISDATA,
        `Bid Price ($/MWh)` = SCH_BID_Y1AXISDATA,
        `Date` = STARTTIME
        )
```

curves <- test |>

paired <- curves |>

    names_from = RESOURCEBID_SEQ,
    values_from = curve

```{r}
# each curve has two cols (SCH_BID_XAXISDATA and SCH_BID_Y1AXISDATA) for one hour
# interpolates values for full x range
metrics <- function(curve1, curve2) {
  x1 <- curve1$SCH_BID_XAXISDATA
  y1 <- curve1$SCH_BID_Y1AXISDATA

  x2 <- curve2$SCH_BID_XAXISDATA
  y2 <- curve2$SCH_BID_Y1AXISDATA

  # to avoid exptrapolating:
  xmin <- max(min(x1), min(x2))
  xmax <- min(max(x1), max(x2))

  x_grid <- seq(
    # min(curve1$SCH_BID_XAXISDATA, curve2$SCH_BID_XAXISDATA, na.rm = TRUE),
    # max(curve1$SCH_BID_XAXISDATA, curve2$SCH_BID_XAXISDATA, na.rm = TRUE),
    xmin, xmax,
    length.out = 200
  )

  interp1 <- approx(x1, y1, xout = x_grid, rule = 1)$y
  interp2 <- approx(x2, y2, xout = x_grid, rule = 1)$y

  # area between curves
  # area_1 <- sum(diff(x_grid) * (head(interp1, -1) + tail(interp1, -1)) / 2)
  # area_2 <- sum(diff(x_grid) * (head(interp2, -1) + tail(interp2, -1)) / 2)

  # diff <- abs(area_1 - area_2)
  # area_between <- sum(diff(x_grid) * (head(diff, -1) + tail(diff, -1)) / 2)
  y_diff <- abs(interp1-interp2)
  area_between <- sum(diff(x_grid)*(head(y_diff, -1) + tail(y_diff, -1))/2)

  # Pearson correlation
  pearson <- cor(interp1, interp2)
  if (is.na(pearson)) {
    print("At least one bid curve is a flat line.")
  }

  # mean square difference
  # not sum sq bc diff xranges BUT still don't know if this is correct
  # msq <- sum((interp1 - interp2)^2) / (xmax - xmin)
  msq <- mean((interp1 - interp2)^2) / (xmax - xmin)

  # Wasserstein (Earth Mover) distance on normalized curves
  interp1_pos <- pmax(interp1, 0)
  interp2_pos <- pmax(interp2, 0)
  area_1_w <- sum(
    diff(x_grid) * (head(interp1_pos, -1) + tail(interp1_pos, -1)) / 2
  )
  area_2_w <- sum(
    diff(x_grid) * (head(interp2_pos, -1) + tail(interp2_pos, -1)) / 2
  )
  wasserstein <- NA_real_
  if (
    is.finite(area_1_w) && is.finite(area_2_w) && area_1_w > 0 && area_2_w > 0
  ) {
    dens1 <- interp1_pos / area_1_w
    dens2 <- interp2_pos / area_2_w
    cdf1 <- c(0, cumsum(diff(x_grid) * (head(dens1, -1) + tail(dens1, -1)) / 2))
    cdf2 <- c(0, cumsum(diff(x_grid) * (head(dens2, -1) + tail(dens2, -1)) / 2))
    wasserstein <- sum(
      diff(x_grid) *
        (head(abs(cdf1 - cdf2), -1) +
          tail(abs(cdf1 - cdf2), -1)) /
        2
    )
  }

  tibble(
    metric = c("area_between", "pearson", "msq", "wasserstein"),
    value = c(area_between, pearson, msq, wasserstein)
  )
}

metrics(paired[7,2][[1]][[1]], paired[7,3][[1]][[1]])
```

```{r}
ex1 <- tibble(SCH_BID_XAXISDATA = c(65, 110, 111, 112, 113, 114, 115,
                                    0,20.5,30.1,39.8,59.1,59.1,60.3,96),
                  SCH_BID_Y1AXISDATA = c(54, -6, -21, -26, -27, -147, -147,
                                        35.7,37.2,38.7,40.2,41.7,500,500,500),
              id = c(rep(1,7), rep(2,8)))

ex1 |>
  ggplot(aes(x=SCH_BID_XAXISDATA, y=SCH_BID_Y1AXISDATA, 
             group=id,color=as.factor(id))) +
  geom_path() +
  geom_point() +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Bid Curves Example",
       color="Curve",
       x="Quantity (MW)",
       y="Bid Price ($/MWh)")

metrics(ex1[1:7,], ex1[7:15,])
```
